SELECT 
    d.devregistry,
    d.profcount,
    d.dpires,
    d.mcresptime,
    t.pollratehz,
    t.inplagms,
    t.resptimems,
    m.swtchdur,
    m.swtchcons,
    m.keychatter,
    i.joyprec,
    i.dpadacc
FROM deviceidentity d
JOIN testsessions t ON d.devsessionref = t.sessionregistry
JOIN mechanical m ON d.devregistry = m.mechdevref
JOIN interactionandcontrol i ON d.devregistry = i.interactdevref
LIMIT 3;

WITH device_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        d.devregistry,
        d.profcount,
        d.dpires,
        d.mcresptime,
        t.pollratehz,
        t.inplagms,
        t.resptimems,
        m.swtchdur,
        m.swtchcons,
        m.keychatter,
        i.joyprec,
        i.dpadacc
    FROM deviceidentity d
    JOIN testsessions t ON d.devsessionref = t.sessionregistry
    JOIN mechanical m ON d.devregistry = m.mechdevref
    JOIN interactionandcontrol i ON d.devregistry = i.interactdevref
),
spi_calc AS (
    SELECT *,
        CAST(dpires AS numeric) / 1000.0 * (1.0 - mcresptime / 10.0) * 10.0 AS spi
    FROM device_metrics
),
irs_calc AS (
    SELECT *,
        CAST(pollratehz AS numeric) / 100.0 * (1.0 - (inplagms + resptimems) / 30.0) * 10.0 AS irs
    FROM spi_calc
),
spr_calc AS (
    SELECT *,
        LOG10(swtchdur::numeric) / 7.0 * swtchcons * (1.0 - keychatter / 2.0) AS spr
    FROM irs_calc
),
rai_calc AS (
    SELECT *,
        ((joyprec + dpadacc) / 20.0) * (1.0 - inplagms / 10.0) * 10.0 AS rai
    FROM spr_calc
),
cgpi_calc AS (
    SELECT *,
        (irs * 0.4) + (spi * 0.3) + (spr * 0.2) + (rai * 0.1) AS cgpi
    FROM rai_calc
),
par_calc AS (
    SELECT *,
        (cgpi / 10.0) * (1.0 + profcount::numeric / 5.0) * ((spi + irs) / 15.0) AS par
    FROM cgpi_calc
)
SELECT 
    devregistry,
    cgpi AS competitive_gaming_performance,
    profcount,
    ROUND(CAST(spi AS numeric), 2) AS sensor_performance,
    ROUND(CAST(irs AS numeric), 2) AS input_responsiveness_score,
    ROUND(CAST(par AS numeric), 2) AS adoption_rate_value
FROM par_calc
ORDER BY par DESC;
